title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
note: Abstract summarised for the offline demo corpus.
abstract: Retrieval augmented generation degrades sharply when the retriever returns irrelevant passages, and the generator tends to trust whatever it is given. The authors add a lightweight retrieval evaluator that scores each retrieved document for relevance and triggers one of three actions: use the document, query the web for better sources, or answer from the model's own knowledge. A decompose-then-recompose step filters out irrelevant sentences before generation. The method improves robustness on short and long form tasks and works as a plug-in for existing pipelines.
